notes.after: sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor
notes.text: Greek Parakleton: Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, and Comfortor.

notes.after: And he is the atoning sacrifice
notes.text: "atoning sacrifice" is from the Greek "hilasmos," an appeasing, propitiating, or the means of appeasement or propitiation-- the sacrifice that turns away God's wrath because of our sin.

notes.after: For there are three who testify
notes.text: Only a few recent manuscripts add "in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. And there are three that testify on earth"
